import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    
    min_error = 1e20
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 0
    target = x / y
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        approx = round(target * i)
        error = abs(approx / i - target)
        
        if error < min_error:
            min_error = error
            best_num = approx
            best_den = i
    
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
